§6Presser§f

§aExtract honey, oil, tofu, and sugar through mechanical pressing.§f

The Presser is a multi-purpose extraction block used in many HarvestCraft chains. It runs without power, just drop items in and collect outputs.

Key recipes: Honeycomb becomes §e2 Honey§f + Grain Bait. Waxcomb becomes §e2 Beeswax§f + Grain Bait. Soybeans become §e2 Silken Tofu§f. Sugar Cane becomes Sugar. Seeds and nuts become Cooking Oil. Fresh Water becomes §e2 Bubbly Water§f for sodas.

Each item processes in §e125 ticks§f (~6.25 seconds). Automate with hoppers or itemducts (in from top, out from bottom).

Craft with §e5 iron ingots§f, §e2 iron blocks§f, and §e1 piston§f.

§ePS:§f The Presser also produces bait as a byproduct on many recipes, which feeds into your Ground Traps and Water Traps.
